plan.notes: Official Bellin College 2026-2027 Handbook and Catalog, Diagnostic Cardiac Sonography Certificate — a two-semester plan of study for students with prior RVT credentials through ARDMS. A DCS certificate is awarded on completion of all courses in the academic plan (cumulative GPA 2.0+, 400 clinical hours, all required clinical competencies). Catalog total of 10 credits verified against course sums (5+5). DMS 350 Physics Synthesis is a conditional pre-Fall requirement (needed only if the ARDMS SPI exam was not taken within the past 5 years) and is therefore excluded from the sequenced total and recorded in external_prereqs. This is a sub-4-term completion program, so program_type is professional-phase. Credit hour ratio: 1 theory credit = 15 hrs; 1 lab = 45 hrs; 1 clinical = 200 hrs.
